answers.core: drawing in VisualServer gives an incredible performance advantage due to batching and semi-manual control of the process, but the whole impression is spoiled by the absence of a zone cleaning mode. All the power of this rendering method loses its relevance due to the lack of elementary cleaning.
answers.workaround: there is only one way to get around, paint in any color, which is certainly not acceptable for the alpha layer
